Repository: platform
What the code contains: `platform` is a Python project with 310 module(s), 84 HTTP endpoint(s), a command line (`backend/src/hmap/agents/docgen/compile_report.py`, `backend/src/hmap/core/runtime/host.py`, `infra/observability/load/soak.py`) and 110 test file(s). Its main parts are `backend/alembic/`, `backend/src/hmap/`, `hmap.agents`, `hmap.api`, `hmap.core`, `hmap.db`, `hmap.manager`, `hmap.obs`.
Summary of the code: The repository implements a hierarchical multi‑agent AI execution platform called hmap, where the core runtime and contracts live in `backend/src/hmap/core/` (e.g., `backend/src/hmap/core/config.py` and `backend/src/hmap/core/runtime/base.py`) and define settings, error taxonomy, tracing, and the agent interface. The manager (`hmap.manager`) orchestrates task state, assignment and graph execution, while persistence is handled by `hmap.db` with a Postgres connection pool and migrations in `backend/alembic/`. Observability utilities in `hmap.obs` provide tracing and metrics, and the composition root `backend/src/hmap/system.py` builds the full platform in a single process. API endpoints are exposed via FastAPI in `backend/src/hmap/api/app.py`, and various agents (e.g., documentation, research, testing) contribute specialized functionality through their models and runtime code. Supporting tooling in `scripts/hmaptools/` offers ownership checks, regression attribution, secret scanning and test result reporting, and load testing is provided by `infra/observability/load/`.
